title: Winey Dense Thai Duck Legs Nam Prik
description: A rich and savory Thai dish featuring wine-marinated duck legs, nuka-pickled cucumbers, and a spicy nam prik sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, palm sugar, 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to make the marinade. Add the duck legs and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the duck legs from the marinade and sear until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer the duck legs to the oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the sliced ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the chili peppers and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Add the nuka-pickled cucumbers and cook for 1 minute, stirring to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, brown sugar, and water to make the nam prik sauce. Pour the sauce over the duck legs and simmer until the sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
Season the dish with salt and lemon juice to taste. Serve warm, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
